title: ai.cover_decision
description: M9B: AI-TRENCH-A-01 doctrine cover decision. Fires when the doctrine ticks for a garrisoned actor (typically on a fire_step trench segment). `reason_label` is one of 4 spec-mandated values; non-cosmetic (cannot be dropped under M4 backpressure) per VAL-M9B-AICOVER-001. Spec §"Acceptance criteria — AI doctrine garrisons trench and uses cover state correctly".

cosmetic.description: Per VAL-M9B-AICOVER-001 / VAL-M9B-REPLAY-002: sim-relevant event, never droppable under M4 backpressure.
